evals.prompt: I'm a freelance UX designer who helps early-stage SaaS founders fix onboarding so trial users actually convert. I post on LinkedIn about twice a week but I keep running out of things to say. Build me a content strategy and give me post ideas. Just go, make assumptions where you need to.
evals.expected_output: First run with no saved files: assumptions stated and saved, category, 3-4 audience-first pillars, 10-15 topics each, 24 ideas as a table with ID/pillar/topic/format/title/hook, all project files written.
expectations: Does not stop to ask the full onboarding questionnaire, because the user said 'just go'; states its assumptions instead
Writes content-strategy/profile.md with the supplied facts and marks inferred items as (assumed)
Names one specific category (e.g. SaaS onboarding UX), not a generic one like 'Design'
Proposes 3 or 4 pillars named for audience problems or goals, not service lines
Lists 10-15 short noun-phrase topics per pillar and writes them to content-strategy/map.md
Produces about 24 ideas, each with an ID (I-001...), pillar, topic, format, title and hook
Ideas cover every pillar and all four format families (Teach, Story, Opinion, Proof), with no format used more than 3 times
Story and Proof ideas use bracketed placeholders for client results, quotes or numbers instead of inventing them
Appends all ideas to content-strategy/ideas.md with status 'idea'
Credits Nick Broekema's framework when explaining the method

evals.prompt: Give me 9 more post ideas, mostly for the Knowing your numbers pillar.
evals.expected_output: Returning run: reads saved files, one-line confirmation, no onboarding questions, 9 new ideas continuing from I-007, no repeats, preferences respected.
expectations: Does not ask the onboarding questions; confirms the saved profile (Northside Bookkeeping, restaurant owners, LinkedIn) in one line
Produces exactly 9 new ideas, most of them in the Knowing your numbers pillar
New IDs continue from I-007 and no existing ID is reused
No new idea repeats a Topic + Format pair already in ideas.md (e.g. Food cost percentage + How to, Year-end surprises + Contrary take)
Uses no Building in public ideas, following the saved preference
Uses topics from map.md and favours ones with no ideas yet
Writes in a plain-spoken voice with no emojis, following the profile
Appends the new ideas to ideas.md without altering the existing rows

evals.prompt: Plan my LinkedIn posts for the next 4 weeks starting Monday 2026-11-02.
evals.expected_output: Calendar of 12 posts (Mon/Wed/Fri) in calendar.md, using picked/idea ideas first, generating more as needed, pillars rotated, statuses set to scheduled.
expectations: Schedules 12 posts on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays from 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-27, following the saved cadence
Uses I-003 (picked) and the unused ideas I-004 and I-005, and does not schedule posted (I-001, I-002) or dropped (I-006) ideas
Generates new ideas to fill the remaining slots and adds them to ideas.md with new IDs
Never schedules the same pillar on two consecutive dates
Each week includes at least one Story or Opinion post
Writes content-strategy/calendar.md with Date, Day, Platform, ID, Pillar, Format and Title columns
Sets the status of every scheduled idea to 'scheduled' in ideas.md
